verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents a fast scaffolded quickstart, but that path targets a browser conversation, not a phone call. Its development runner does terminate telephony WebSockets, and there is a documented Twilio dev command (`-t twilio -x ngrok`), so a phone bot is a documented path. However, the phone number must come from an external carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo and others), and a tunnel is needed, so the end-to-end phone flow depends on outside tools. Missing for 10: first-party phone number provisioning, a documented phone-specific quickstart with a time-to-first-call claim, and hands-on corroboration of a first live phone call within an hour.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: Build and run your first Pipecat voice AI bot in under 5 minutes: a simple conversational agent you can talk to in a browser.
